title: Logit-normal timestep sampling
change: Replace uniform timestep sampling with logit-normal distribution (mean 0, scale 1) for training.
mechanism: Logit-normal sampling concentrates training on intermediate timesteps where velocity prediction is most informative, improving sample efficiency and lowering val_loss within the 2-minute budget.

title: Boundary-focused timestep sampling
change: Add a small probability (e.g., 0.1) of sampling timesteps near t=0 and t=1 (e.g., uniform in [0,0.05] and [0.95,1]) in addition to uniform sampling.
mechanism: Emphasizing boundary timesteps improves velocity accuracy at the endpoints of the flow, which is critical for rectified flow training and can reduce overall velocity MSE.

title: Curriculum timestep schedule
change: Implement a curriculum that gradually reduces the sampling frequency of easy timesteps (near t=1) over training, starting uniform and shifting toward harder timesteps.
mechanism: Curriculum learning improves training efficiency by focusing on harder timesteps as training progresses, leading to faster convergence and lower val_loss in the limited time budget.

title: Momentum decay for AdamW
change: Decay AdamW beta1 from 0.9 to 0.5 linearly over training (or use a schedule that reduces momentum).
mechanism: Reducing momentum during training helps avoid oscillations in the smooth loss landscape of diffusion models, accelerating convergence and improving final val_loss.

title: SNR-focused timestep weighting
change: Weight the velocity loss by a function that emphasizes timesteps with moderate signal-to-noise ratio (e.g., weight = 1/(SNR+1) normalized).
mechanism: Focusing on informative SNR levels reduces variance in the loss estimator and improves training efficiency, leading to lower val_loss in the short budget.
